mapper.select: select od.name as name, od.number as number from tb_courier_trade_order tcto left join orders o on tcto.order_number = o.number left join order_detail od on o.id = od.order_id where tcto.trade_no = #{tradeNo}

select * from tb_courier_trade_order
and courier_id = #{courierId} and waybill_status = #{status}
and trade_complete_time > concat(#{today}, ' 00:00:00') and trade_complete_time < concat(#{today}, ' 23:59:59')
and trade_cancel_time > concat(#{today}, ' 00:00:00') and trade_cancel_time < concat(#{today}, ' 23:59:59')

select ifnull(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, trade_create_time, trade_complete_time)), 0) from tb_courier_trade_order where trade_create_time between concat(#{firstDayOfMonth}, ' 00:00:00') and concat(#{lastDayOfMonth}, ' 23:59:59') and waybill_status = 4 and courier_id = #{courierId}

select count(*) from tb_courier_trade_order where waybill_status = 4 and trade_create_time between concat(#{firstDayOfMonth}, ' 00:00:00') and concat(#{lastDayOfMonth}, ' 23:59:59') and trade_complete_time < customer_expected_delivery_time and courier_id = #{courierId}

select
ifnull(MAX(case when temp.date = '${date}' then temp.total end), 0) as `${date}`
from (select DATE_FORMAT(trade_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') date, count(*) as total from tb_courier_trade_order where trade_create_time between concat(#{firstDayOfMonth}, ' 00:00:00') and concat(#{lastDayOfMonth}, ' 23:59:59') and waybill_status = #{status} and courier_id = #{courierId} order by DATE_FORMAT(trade_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) temp
